12. INSTALL SUPPORT STOPPER BOLT
Install the cover to the bolt, and align the cutout portion of the support stopper bolt to the bracket, install it from inside of the column upper bracket.
Torque: 110 kg·cm (8 ft·lb, 11 N·m)

13. INSTALL SPACER AND PIN

14. INSTALL TILT LEVER RETAINER
(a) Install the tilt lever retainer with the collar, cushion and bolt.
Torque: 195 kg·cm (14 ft·lb, 19 N·m)
(b) Temporarily install the two nuts and washers.

(c) Hold the serration bolt and tighten the two nuts.
Torque: 195 kg·cm (14 ft·lb, 19 N·m)

15. SELECT SUPPORT SHIM
Select one or two shims which fit snugly when pressed in by hand.

Mark          Thickness  mm (in.)
None    0.197 - 0.203    (0.0078 - 0.0080)
5       0.495 - 0.505    (0.0195 - 0.0199)
8       0.795 - 0.805    (0.0313 - 0.0317)
14      1.395 - 1.405    (0.0549 - 0.0553)
18      1.795 - 1.805    (0.0707 - 0.0711)
